summary.name: UI Animation / Product Motion Design: a commercial presentation format, not an art movement. Provenance is explicit.
summary.visualIdentity: Accurate product interfaces with real copy and branding. Cards, numbers, charts and states animate as separate elements. Features are explained through causal state changes, shared elements and precise camera framing.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: feature demos built from real interfaces. Inferred: product launch and release reels, and interactive feature tours. Add diagrams only where the interface cannot show a relationship.
summary.limitations: Needs real product assets, exact copy and brand tokens; if absent, report the gap rather than inventing UI or copy. Never slide whole screenshots. Two-color contrast checks do not verify composited frames.
summary.palette: Background is scene_dependent, chosen from subject, lighting and mood, not a default cream. #F7F9FA and #263440 are illustrative chrome tokens only; brand and product colors override them. Source colors are not approved. No gradients. Recheck composited contrast.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Causal chain: tap, card expands as a shared element (FLIP measured once), numbers count, chart path transitions, then a hold. Camera is a wrapper transform. Video uses one paused GSAP timeline; live input is interactive-only. The 3s timing is an adaptable example, not a mandate.
summary.audio: Not specified or verified. Options depend on the brief: restrained interaction accents, ambience, music or silence. Keep sound clear of narration and text, and sync only to measured audio timing.
summary.assetRequirements: Real product screenshots or layered PNG/SVG with alpha, brand fonts and exact copy, supplied by the user. X-ray reveal needs registered exterior and interior layers. Ranked-data variants need an authorized, cited, time-indexed dataset.
summary.combinations: Works alone. Optional: style-093 for short kinetic feature headlines; style-109 for connectors between UI cards with one stroke width. Motion references 008, 012, 013, 015 and 018 suit product stories; 017 only for separable parts.
summary.productionApproach: DOM/HTML-CSS for real UI type and SVG for chart states, with one paused GSAP timeline and one owner per property. HyperFrames is the default pipeline (check, snapshot, render); Remotion only with a recorded, verified reason. Verify decoded frames and direct and backward seeks.
